topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: My sister and I have just inherited our grandmother's house. It’s a lot to take in, really. The house holds so many memories, and now it's all on us to decide what to do with it. We've been talking about renovations, about what rooms might need work, and how to preserve the old, while making it livable. The thought of selling it crosses my mind, but it feels almost... disrespectful, like letting go of a part of her. Every corner reminds me of her, the way she would brew her tea in the kitchen, the old rocking chair in the living room. There’s a weight to this decision, and I find myself hesitating at every turn. We’ve got to meet with a lawyer soon to sort out the legalities. It’s a lot, but maybe we can find a way to honor her memory while moving forward.
